chat_turns_contact_check.name: chat_turns_contact_check

chat_turns_machine_wait_at_check.name: chat_turns_machine_wait_at_check
chat_turns_machine_wait_at_check.value: "chat_turns"."machine_wait" is null or "chat_turns"."machine_wait_at" is not null

chats_profile_set_by_check.name: chats_profile_set_by_check
chats_profile_set_by_check.value: "chats"."profile_id" is null or "chats"."profile_set_by" is not null

chats_branch_check.name: chats_branch_check
chats_branch_check.value: "chats"."branched_from_turn_id" is null or "chats"."branched_from_chat_id" is not null

chats_task_check.name: chats_task_check
chats_task_check.value: ("chats"."task_id" is null) = ("chats"."task_step_id" is null) and ("chats"."task_id" is null) = ("chats"."task_round" is null) and ("chats"."task_round" is null or "chats"."task_round" >= 1)

contacts_slack_check.name: contacts_slack_check
contacts_slack_check.value: "contacts"."source" <> 'slack' or ("contacts"."slack_team_id" is not null and "contacts"."slack_user_id" is not null)

access_profiles_claude_check.name: access_profiles_claude_check
access_profiles_claude_check.value: "access_profiles"."claude_part" or ("access_profiles"."claude_credential_id" is null and "access_profiles"."claude_gateway_credential_id" is null and "access_profiles"."claude_model" is null and "access_profiles"."claude_effort" is null and "access_profiles"."claude_mode" is null)

access_profiles_openai_check.name: access_profiles_openai_check
access_profiles_openai_check.value: "access_profiles"."openai_part" or ("access_profiles"."openai_credential_id" is null and "access_profiles"."openai_gateway_credential_id" is null and "access_profiles"."openai_model" is null and "access_profiles"."openai_effort" is null and "access_profiles"."openai_mode" is null)

access_profiles_github_check.name: access_profiles_github_check
access_profiles_github_check.value: "access_profiles"."github_credential_id" is null or "access_profiles"."github_rights" is not null

access_profiles_atlassian_check.name: access_profiles_atlassian_check
access_profiles_atlassian_check.value: "access_profiles"."atlassian_credential_id" is null or "access_profiles"."atlassian_rights" is not null

access_profiles_slack_check.name: access_profiles_slack_check
access_profiles_slack_check.value: "access_profiles"."slack_credential_id" is null or "access_profiles"."slack_rights" is not null

credential_uses_company_check.name: credential_uses_company_check
credential_uses_company_check.value: "credential_uses"."company_id" is not null or ("credential_uses"."agent_id" is null and "credential_uses"."chat_id" is null and "credential_uses"."principal_id" is null)

flow_steps_limit_check.name: flow_steps_limit_check
flow_steps_limit_check.value: "flow_steps"."send_back_limit" is null or ("flow_steps"."kind" <> 'work' and "flow_steps"."send_back_limit" between 1 and 99)

lead_wake_events_woke_check.name: lead_wake_events_woke_check
lead_wake_events_woke_check.value: ("lead_wake_events"."outcome" = 'woke') = ("lead_wake_events"."turn_id" is not null) and ("lead_wake_events"."turn_id" is null) = ("lead_wake_events"."chat_id" is null)

enrollment_tokens_machine_check.name: enrollment_tokens_machine_check
enrollment_tokens_machine_check.value: "enrollment_tokens"."machine_id" is null or "enrollment_tokens"."used_at" is not null

room_messages_turn_check.name: room_messages_turn_check
room_messages_turn_check.value: "room_messages"."turn_id" is null or "room_messages"."chat_id" is not null

slack_connections_app_token_check.name: slack_connections_app_token_check
slack_connections_app_token_check.value: ("slack_connections"."app_key_version" is null) = ("slack_connections"."app_ciphertext" is null) and ("slack_connections"."app_iv" is null) = ("slack_connections"."app_ciphertext" is null) and ("slack_connections"."app_auth_tag" is null) = ("slack_connections"."app_ciphertext" is null)

task_artifacts_bytes_check.name: task_artifacts_bytes_check
task_artifacts_bytes_check.value: ("task_artifacts"."kind" in ('file', 'note')) = ("task_artifacts"."bytes" is not null) and ("task_artifacts"."bytes" is null) = ("task_artifacts"."content_type" is null) and ("task_artifacts"."bytes" is null) = ("task_artifacts"."sha256" is null) and ("task_artifacts"."bytes" is null or octet_length("task_artifacts"."bytes") = "task_artifacts"."size")

tasks_escalation_check.name: tasks_escalation_check
tasks_escalation_check.value: ("tasks"."state" = 'escalated') = ("tasks"."escalation_reason" is not null) and ("tasks"."escalation_target_step_id" is null or "tasks"."state" = 'escalated')

tasks_blocked_reason_check.name: tasks_blocked_reason_check
tasks_blocked_reason_check.value: "tasks"."blocked_reason" is null or ("tasks"."step_state" = 'blocked' and char_length("tasks"."blocked_reason") between 1 and 2000)
